description.value: Land is a cafe, brunch spot, and yoga studio rolled into one, sitting on the banks of the Chilliwack River near Vedder Mountain. The kitchen is entirely vegetarian — leaning plant-forward with creative dishes like Turkish eggs, spicy peanut soba bowls, and falafel med bowls, most of which can be made vegan or gluten-free. It bills itself as an 'Everyday Retreat,' making it a genuinely restorative stop for cyclists exploring the Vedder area trails.

address.value: 45530 Vedder Mountain Road, Unit 102, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4C3

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 32m; rack (5 spaces) at 41m; rack (12 spaces) at 43m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms this is a real, active business: a combined cafe and yoga studio at 102-45530 Vedder Mountain Rd, Chilliwack. The menu page explicitly states 'WE LOVE PLANTS. Our menu is entirely vegetarian and most items can be made vegan,' with GF notations on multiple dishes. The 'Order Online' feature confirms takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging is found anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name is simply 'Land' but the business consistently calls itself 'Land Cafe & Yoga Studio' or 'Land Studio & Cafe' on its website — minor name mismatch.
OSM has no phone number; website shows 778-347-5778 (formatted from 7783475778). Phone added from website only.
OSM tags do not reflect the yoga/fitness studio component of the business, which is a significant part of the operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe and yoga studio with a full menu and confirmed location. Strong fit for touring cyclists seeking a plant-forward brunch stop near Vedder Mountain.
